svg.title: Every placebo-controlled phase 2 or 3 SS-31 (elamipretide) trial with an efficacy goal, and whether it hit that goal
svg.desc: Scorecard of 13 trials. None clearly met its main goal: 9 missed, 2 were borderline at P = 0.053 and P = 0.055, and 2 completed heart failure trials never posted results. 2016, Heart attack (STEMI) during stenting, 297 people: missed. 2017, Kidney artery narrowing (stenting), 14 people: missed. 2017, Hospitalized heart failure, 308 people: no results. 2017, Heart failure, preserved EF, 46 people: no results. 2018, Mitochondrial myopathy (MMPOWER-1), 36 people: borderline. 2020, Heart failure, reduced EF (PROGRESS-HF), 71 people: missed. 2020, Mitochondrial myopathy (MMPOWER-2), 30 people: missed. 2021, Healthy older adults with low muscle ATP, 39 people: borderline. 2021, Barth syndrome (TAZPOWER, part 1), 12 people: missed. 2023, Mitochondrial myopathy (MMPOWER-3), 218 people: missed. 2024, Dry AMD with geographic atrophy (ReCLAIM-2), 176 people: missed. 2024, Leber optic neuropathy (eye drops), 12 people: missed. 2026, Nuclear-DNA mitochondrial disease (NuPower), 102 people: missed.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
